cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The SPI cable select pin to use.

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this MCP3204 component.

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*

reference_voltage.docs:
**float**: The reference voltage. Defaults to `3.3V`.

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*

diff_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Enable differential mode measurement. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*

mcp3204_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the parent MCP3204 component.

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*

number.docs:
**int**: The pin to measure on the MCP3204/MCP3208

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [MCP3204 & MCP3208 12-Bit A/D Converters](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3204#configuration-variables)*
